senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. תָּלָה, דָּלָה)to hang on, to patch, line.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:2">Kel. XXVI, 2</cite> <he>טלא עליו וכ׳</he> Ar. (Mish. ed. <he>טלה</he>, Talm. ed. <cite ref="I00492"><he>טִילָּה</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="M01010"><he>מַטְלִית</he></cite>. Ib. XXVII, 6 <he>שטְלָיָיהּ וכ׳</he> which he put on &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:11">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite> top <he>וטוֹלִין</he>, v. <cite ref="M01010"><he>מַטְלִית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 122b:17">Ḥull. 122ᵇ</cite> <he>שטְלָאָהּ לקופתו</he> which he hanged over his basket.
<cite ref="Gittin 45b:9">Gitt. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>ט׳ עליהן עור</he> covered them with a leather casing.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="I00491">same</cite>, v. supra. Part. pass. <cite ref="M00982"><he>מְטוּלָּא</he></cite>, pl. <he>מְטוּלָּאִים</he>.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 43b:15">Ber. 43ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מנעלים המט׳</he> patched shoes; v. <cite ref="I00471"><he>טְלָאי</he></cite>.
